overview: This enum restricts how a mission fighter joins special-tag combo sequences.

None.simple: No special-tag combo limit is set.
None.technical: The row constructor uses None, and story setup copies the raw byte into Setup.Byte89 before AGameCharacter stores it as SetupSpecialTagComboLimit. The observed raw checks only react to 2 and 3, so this value leaves pair sequences allowed and does not swap performers.

Common.simple: The fighter uses the common special-tag combo rule.
Common.technical: Declared as Common in the enum. No source compares this value with 1 specifically, and the read-only mission export contains no Common entry. The observed raw checks treat it as neither Unique nor Both.

Unique.simple: This fighter prevents pair special-tag sequences.
Unique.technical: FStudioBattleState_06::IsPairSequenceAllowed returns whether the first performer's SetupSpecialTagComboLimit is not 2, so this value makes that check false. PlayTagComboSequence reads the result before choosing a tag-combo team sequence.

Both.simple: This fighter changes which teammate leads the tag combo.
Both.technical: FStudioBattleSystem310 builds TagComboGroup from the performers and swaps Characters[0] with Characters[1] when the first character's GetCharacterSpecialTagComboLimit returns 3. The getter returns SetupSpecialTagComboLimit.

Invalid.simple: An invalid special-tag combo limit is declared.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the 255 sentinel. No source compares this value with 255 specifically, and the read-only mission export contains no Invalid entry. The observed raw checks treat it as neither Unique nor Both.

notes: The two explicit consumers read the raw byte. The larger state and system names are reconstruction terminology.
Only story battle setup was found copying CharacterSpecialTagComboLimit into Setup.Byte89. Other setup paths leave Byte89 at its default unless they assign it elsewhere.
The read-only MissionCharacterDataTable export uses None, Unique, and Both.
